classification.difficultyReason: Select an exponential graph using its growth or decay behaviour and y-intercept.

content.prompt: Which graph best represents the graph of $y=10(0.8)^x$?

spec.description: Four schematic exponential graphs in one comparison row, ordered A–D. Each has positive-direction axis arrows, x and y labels, and only its supplied y-intercept label. Viewing ranges are schematic because the source supplies no numerical x scale.
spec.mathematics: A: positive decreasing exponential with y-intercept 10. B: positive decreasing exponential with y-intercept 8. C: positive increasing exponential with y-intercept 10. D: positive increasing exponential with y-intercept 8. All have horizontal asymptote y=0.
spec.answerVisibility: All four option curves are permanent question givens.

answer.worked: Since $0<0.8<1$, the graph shows exponential decay. At $x=0$, $y=10(0.8)^0=10$, so the $y$-intercept is $10$. Correct answer: A.
